content: Yagan-ambegwadgi (10) burbar sunmaklenaid
Degi Jesús sogdebalid: “Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid ome-nikunaid-ibagi-gusayob gued: A-ibagi yagana-ambegwad (10) ome-nikulenaid-ibase-naega, na gwallu egad-egad sesmalad, adi, suiga-guoed-abindaknaegar.
Dakleargu, e-ataledi, nue-binsaed-nikaa damalad. Bamaladdi, gwen binsaed nikasurmalad.
E-ataled-binsaed-surmaladi, gwallu-sesmargua, gwen e-gwallu-dii bute-baidgi enossurmalad.
Ar e-atar-binsaed-nikadamaladdi, gwallu-sesmargua, bute-baidgi gwallu-dii sesmarbalid.
Ar suiga-guoed amba yoggudsoggu, bela yagana gabed-itoarmargu, gabidmarsunnad.
”Nega-gabigwengi binnasur dule-gole itoarmalad: ‘¡Suiga-guoed dani! ¡Abin-daknamar!’
”Geb degi, bela yagana gwisguarmalad. E-gwallu gatik-nued-gaega, nudakarmalad.
E-atar-binsaedsulidi, e-atar-binsaed-nikadamaladga sogdemalad: ‘Be anmarga wis gwallu-dii ukdage, ar anmar-ibe gwallu akinmaid.’
”Yagan-binsaed-nikadamalad abin-sogdemalad: ‘Suli. Ar anmar bemarga gwallu-dii abar-ukye-sogele, anmarga galakuoed, degi, bemarga galakumogoed. Bur be dulemar-gwalludii-ukmaladse baknamala.’
”Geb yagan-binsaed-sulidamalad gwallu-dii baknadmargu, a-sorba suiga-guoedi nonikid. Yagan-binsaed-nikadamaladdi, guakwaa-bukmarsoggu, eba mas-gunnega dogdemalad. A-sorba, yawagak edilessunnad.
”Geb agi yagan-ataled-gwallu-dii-bakdimalad nonimarmogad. Suiga-guoedga wilesakwaa sognai guarmalad: ‘¡Dummad, anmarga be yawagak wis egae!’
”Ar dummad abin-imakdegu, sogded: ‘Napira an bemarga soged, aku an bemar-daked.’ ”
Degi Jesús sogdebalid: “Degisoggu, nue nakulemar. Ar be wissurmalad ibi-ibagi, igi-wachigi Dule-Machi danikoe.”
Or-manigi burbar sunmaklenaid
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid weyob gued: Dule-wargwen dikasur na e-neggi nasokargu, e-maigan-ega-ibmar-akwega ese gochagusad. Degisoggu, amarga bela na e-ibmar-obes naded.

Mani-onogedsik e-maigan-gurgin-nikadbali, ega or-mani-mimis naded. Wargwenga or-mani-gwaatar ega uksad, baidga or-mani-gwabo uksad, degi, baidga or-mani-gwagwen uksamogad. Mani-ibeddi, dikasur nadsunnad.
”Dule-or-mani-gwaatar-abingasad naded. Geb mani-e-sangi mani-gwaatar onosbalid.
Ar dule-or-mani-gwabo-abingasadi, amba deyob imaksamogad, mani-gwabo egi onosmogad.
Ar dule-or-mani-gwagwen-abingasaddi, nadgu, napagi digdapid. E-dummad-mani napa-yaba odukusad.
”Undaradgine, we-maigan-e-dummad nonikid, e-maigan-ebo mani-igar naboalid.

Dule-or-mani-gwaatar-abingasadi nonigu, baid-or-mani-gwaatar senonibalid. E-dummadga sognonikid: ‘Dummad, or-mani-gwaatar be anga uksad, an baid-or-mani-gwaatar egi onosbalid. Degisoggu, or-mani-gwaambe (10) an bega sedanisunnad, be sue.’
”E-dummad ega sogded: ‘Nued, be mai-nued, be gwen-galakussulid. Ar ibmar-ichesaaledgi gwen galakussuli be arbasad, ibmar-ichesur an bega uksun. Degisoggu, anba be wergudasun.’
”Ar dule-or-mani-gwabo-abingasad nonimogu, e-dummadga sognonimogad: ‘Dummad, or-mani-gwabo be anga uksad, baid-gwabo an egi onosbalid. Degisoggu, or-mani-gwabake an bega sedanisunnad, be sue.’
”E-dummad ega sogded: ‘Nued, be mai-nued, be gwen galakussulid. Ar ibmar-ichesaaledgi gwen galakussuli be arbasad, ibmar-ichesur an bega uksun. Degisoggu, anba be wergudasun.’
”Ar dule-or-mani-gwagwen-abingasad nonimogu, e-dummadga sognonimogad: ‘Dummad, an be-wisdo, be dule-buledid. Be ibmar-digsasulidgi ibmar be weed, degine, be-arbassulidgi ibmar be weebalid.
Degisoggu, an be-dobgusad. An nadgu, be-or-mani napa-yaba an odukusad. Ar begadid, an bega uksun.’
”E-dummad, abin-sogdegu, ega sogded: ‘Be mai-isgana, mai-wiegala. Be wisinad, an-ibmar-digsulidgi an ibmar-weed, degine, an arbasulidgi ibmar an weebalid.
Ar degisoggu, mani-onogosur be itogu, mani-urbemalad-negse be an-mani uknaenad, adi, an nonikogu, an-mani, degi, e-gaka, an na sunonikoenad.’
”Dule-mani-ibed e-mai-baiganga sogded: ‘Degisoggu, e-annik or-mani be sumarsun, dule-or-mani-gwaambe-nikadga (10) be ukmarsun.
Ar dule-ibmar-nikadga bur bule ega ibmar uklegoed. Degisoggu, bur bule ibmar nikunonikoed. Ar dule-ibmar-sateddi, wis-ibmar-nikadse-bakale, ei sulenonikoed.
Ar we-mai-wissur-arbaedi, magaba negsichidse metnamar. Agi bosii guoed, dummad-wilesiidba nugar-gorsii guoed.’ ”
Dule-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwadga igar-itolegoed
Jesús sogded: “Ani Dule-Machi, an-iba-danikoedgi, bela an-baliwiturmar-gwage-swilidikmaladmala an-gangued-yeerdaklegedgi an danikoed. Geb an-ologan-yeerdaklegedgi an signonikoed.

Geb degi, bela dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukmalad an-asabin ambikunonimaloed. Agi geb bachik-bachik an oambikuoed. Igi sibad-wawaad-edarbed, sibad-wawaad, degi, sibad-ebo bachiki urbe, deyob an dulemar-imakmogoed.
An-argan-nuedsiki, sibad-wawaadmar an urboed. An-argan-sapiledsikdi, sibadmar an urboed.

”Geb degi, an reyga-maidba, an-argan-nuedsik-bukmaladga an sogdagoed: ‘Be dagmar, ar an-Bab-Dummad bemargi nued binsasad. An-Bab-neg-dakmaid-bemargadid be abingadamar. Ar we-napneg-nagusad-akale, bato bemarga nugsales nagusad.

content.text: Ar an ukur-itosgu, masgi be an-oguchamalad.
An uku-uku-itosgu, be an-ogobsamalad.
An-neggwebursulidgi an gudigusgu, be an-akwismalad.
An mor-sate-gudigusgu, mor be anga uksamalad.
An uellesgu, an-bendakega be anse atakapmalad.
An esgaryagi-mellesigusgu, be anse arbimalad.’

content: ”Geb degi, dulemar-igar-napiragwadba-damalad an-abin-imakdemaloed, sogdamaloed:

content.text: ‘Dummad, ¿sana ukudmaada an be-daksamala? Masgi an be-oguchaye bede soged.
¿Sana be uku-uku-itodii an be-daksamala? An be-ogobsaye bede soged.
¿Sana be-neggwebursulidgi be gudigu, anmar be-akwismala?
¿Sana mor-sate an be-daksagu, an bega mor yosmala?
Be uellemaigu, be-bendakega, ¿sana anmar bese atakapmala?
Be esgaryagi-mellesigu, ¿sana anmar bese atakapmala?’

content: ”Ani Rey, an abin-imakdoed: ‘Napira an bemarga soged, ar an-gwenadgan-binsarmaladse-bakar, deyob bemar bendaksasoggu, be deyob an-bendaksamalad.’
”Geb degi, dulemar an-argan-sapiledsik-bukmaladga an sogdagoed: ‘Angi be bangumar, bemar bato ukabsalesmalad. Nia-sailaga, degi, e-baliwiturmarga, soo-saila-geg-bergued bato guagwar-siidse be namar.

content.text: Ar ade, ukudmaada an gudigusgu, gwen masgi be an-oguchasurmalad.
Uku-uku an itosgu, gwen be an-ogobsasurmalad.
An-neggwebursulidgi an gudigusgu, gwen be an-akwissurmalad.
Mor-sate an gudigusgu, gwen be anga mor yossurmalad.
An uellemaigusgu, gwen be an-bendakapsurmalad,
degi, esgaryagi an mellesi-gusgu, gwen be anse atakapsurmalad.’

content: ”Geb degi, amar an-abin imakdemarmogoed:

content.text: ‘Dummad, ¿sana be ukudmaad-gudii, uku-uku-itodii, an be-daksamala?
¿Sana be be-neggwebursulidgi-gudii, mor-sate-gudii, an be-daksamala?
¿Sana be uelledigu, esgaryagi-mellesigu, anmar be-bendaksasuli?’

content: ”Geb degi, an wemar-abin-sogoed: ‘Napira an bemarga soged, ar an-gwenadgan-binsarmaladga deyob bemar imaksasursoggu, anga bemar imaksasulid.’
”Degisoggu, we-dule-isganamar, odurdakleged-neg-sadeguoedse barmiledmaloed. Dule-nuegandi, san-burba-geg-bergued-negse namaloed.”
